prompt: Announce the First Baptist church potluck in the style of a monster truck rally ad. Full commitment.
response:
SUNDAY! SUNDAY! SUNDAY!

Get ready for the biggest, loudest, gravy-loaded event of the season at FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH!

It’s the ANNUAL POTLUCK SMACKDOWN — where casseroles collide, crockpots roar, and desserts enter the arena with NO MERCY!

Bring your appetite! Bring your family! Bring that one aunt’s mysterious seven-layer salad! Because this fellowship hall is about to be transformed into the THUNDERDOME OF HOME COOKIN’!

Witness the raw power of:

- Brother Jim’s FIRE-BREATHIN’ BARBECUE BEANS!
- Sister Linda’s TURBO-CHARGED TATER TOT CASSEROLE!
- The unstoppable MACARONI MONSTER!
- And a dessert table so massive, so intense, so life-changing, it may require extra folding chairs!

Kids eat free! Adults eat enthusiastically! Deacons will be standing by with lemonade and napkins!

Doors open right after the morning service. That’s RIGHT AFTER THE MORNING SERVICE!

Don’t you dare go home and make a sandwich when you could be part of the most flavor-packed fellowship event this side of the county line!

FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH POTLUCK!

Come for the worship. Stay for the covered dishes.

You’ll use the whole seat — BUT YOU’LL ONLY NEED THE EDGE!
